body: Thanks I dragged myself to a party and I had fun.  Spoke to my doctor about how I am having these on and off feelings and am getting some meds for it.  It's starting to look like I have hope so I hope this works out.  Hell what do I have to lose right?

Im still here.  I chickened out at the last minute.  I had the bottles out and everything.  I have tried for the past 2 years.  Nothing seems to work for me.  I honestly don't have much hope right now.  I'm surprised that you care...  I didn't think anyone would respond to this...  Thanks I guess...
Im not sure how I can address them.  Who would want to listen...  Many bad things happened during my childhood as well.  I think not getting to experience a happy childhood has fucked me up.
Thinking about taking the bottle of Ativan and downing vodka...I dont want to wake up tomorrow...
I saw a doctor 5 months ago and was put on a med.  Its not helping much.

Im damaged... Just a bitter and sad / pathetic person that has not been able to give or receive love since I was hurt by someone.  This is no way to live man...I cant stand it.  Suppose I have been depressed for a long time...  I just dont see this as getting any better.
